name: ES Initial Balance Range & Break Analysis
description: ES E-mini S&P 500 Initial Balance (09:30–10:30 ET) range distribution and IB break analysis on 1-minute bars. Zero-range days filtered out. Computes IB range per session, classifies narrow/wide via rolling percentile rank, and classifies each day by IB break type (no break, single break, double break). For single-break days, calculates follow-through rate — how often ES closes beyond the broken IB extreme at RTH close (16:00 ET). Reports summary statistics, IB range histogram, and break analysis table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES INITIAL BALANCE RANGE & BREAK ANALYSIS
# ES E-mini S&P 500 Futures — 1-Minute Bars
# =============================================================================
# Initial Balance (IB): 09:30 - 10:30 ET (first 60 minutes of RTH)
# IB Range Metrics: Mean, Median, Mode, Std Dev, Narrow Day %, Wide Day %
# Narrow/Wide terciles based on rolling 252-day percentile rank
# Zero-range days (IB range = 0) filtered out as data artifacts
#
# IB Break Analysis:
#   - No Break: RTH high/low stays within IB range
#   - Single Break: RTH breaches IB high OR IB low (not both)
#   - Double Break: RTH breaches both IB high AND IB low
#   - Follow-Through: % of single-break days where RTH close is beyond
#     the broken IB extreme (close > IB high for upside breaks,
#     close < IB low for downside breaks)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT (unadjusted for intraday session analysis) ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === HOLIDAY FILTER ===
is_holiday = holiday(days_before=0, days_after=0, holiday_calendar=HolidayCalendar.CMEGlobexEquitiesHolidayCalendar)

# === INITIAL BALANCE SESSION (09:30-10:30 ET) ===
ib_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='10:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)
ib_valid_raw = (ib_sw.closed and not is_holiday)

# === ZERO-RANGE FILTER ===
# Filter out days where IB range = 0 (data artifacts / near-zero liquidity)
ib_range_raw = where(ib_valid_raw, ib_sw.high - ib_sw.low)
ib_valid = ib_valid_raw and (ib_range_raw > 0)
ib_range = where(ib_valid, ib_range_raw)

# === NARROW / WIDE CLASSIFICATION ===
# Rolling 252-day percentile rank of IB range (0-100 scale)
# Bottom tercile (<=33) = Narrow day, Top tercile (>=67) = Wide day
ib_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(ib_range)
is_narrow = where(ib_valid, (1.0 if ib_pctrank <= 33 else 0.0))
is_wide = where(ib_valid, (1.0 if ib_pctrank >= 67 else 0.0))

# === SAMPLE COUNT ===
day_count = where(ib_valid, 1.0)

# === FULL RTH SESSION (09:30-16:00 ET) ===
rth_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === CARRY IB LEVELS FORWARD THROUGH RTH ===
# ffill_day carries IB high/low from 10:30 through 16:00 (resets next day)
ib_high_level = ffill_day(where(ib_valid, ib_sw.high))
ib_low_level = ffill_day(where(ib_valid, ib_sw.low))

# === IB BREAK CLASSIFICATION AT RTH CLOSE ===
# Exclude holidays and zero-range days
rth_valid = rth_sw.closed and not is_holiday and (ib_high_level > ib_low_level)

# Did RTH price action breach IB extremes?
broke_up = where(rth_valid, rth_sw.high > ib_high_level)
broke_down = where(rth_valid, rth_sw.low < ib_low_level)

# Break type classification (as % for Mean aggregation)
is_no_break = where(rth_valid, 1.0 if (not broke_up and not broke_down) else 0.0)
is_single_break = where(rth_valid, 1.0 if ((broke_up and not broke_down) or (not broke_up and broke_down)) else 0.0)
is_double_break = where(rth_valid, 1.0 if (broke_up and broke_down) else 0.0)

# === SINGLE-BREAK FOLLOW-THROUGH ANALYSIS ===
# For single-break days, did RTH close extend beyond the broken IB level?
# Upside single break: close > IB high = follow-through
# Downside single break: close < IB low = follow-through
is_single_up = rth_valid and broke_up and not broke_down
is_single_down = rth_valid and not broke_up and broke_down

# Follow-through rates (1.0 = closed beyond, 0.0 = did not)
follow_up = where(is_single_up, 1.0 if rth_sw.close > ib_high_level else 0.0)
follow_down = where(is_single_down, 1.0 if rth_sw.close < ib_low_level else 0.0)

# Combined follow-through: any single-break day where close is beyond broken extreme
follow_any = where(is_single_up or is_single_down, 1.0 if ((is_single_up and rth_sw.close > ib_high_level) or (is_single_down and rth_sw.close < ib_low_level)) else 0.0)

# RTH close day count for break analysis
rth_day_count = where(rth_valid, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- IB Range Statistics Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ES Initial Balance Range Statistics (09:30–10:30 RTH)',
        row_size=7,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Sample Days',
            'Mean IB Range (pts)',
            'Median IB Range (pts)',
            'Mode IB Range (pts)',
            'Std Dev (pts)',
            'Narrow Day % (Bottom Tercile)',
            'Wide Day % (Top Tercile)'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Primary),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mode, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='IB Range Analysis'
)(ib_range, ib_range, ib_range, ib_range, ib_range, is_narrow, is_wide)

# --- IB Range Histogram with Analytics ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of ES Initial Balance Range (Points)',
    category='IB Range Analysis',
    bin_width=0.5,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='IB Range (points)',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    show_analytics=True
)(ib_range)

# --- IB Break Analysis Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ES IB Break Analysis (RTH 09:30–16:00)',
        row_size=7,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'RTH Days Analyzed',
            'No Break %',
            'Single Break %',
            'Double Break %',
            'Single Up Break: Close Beyond IB High %',
            'Single Down Break: Close Beyond IB Low %',
            'All Single Breaks: Follow-Through %'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Primary),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='IB Break Analysis'
)(rth_day_count, is_no_break, is_single_break, is_double_break, follow_up, follow_down, follow_any)
